items.text: Added oidc.user_id_claim to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than sub, such as Microsoft Entra ID's oid · Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does · Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension · Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place
